description.en: Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) for DeepSeek Harness: pair one or more WeChat accounts by scanning a QR code in the Plugins panel, then talk to your agent from WeChat or WeCom with one DSH conversation per contact or group. Text, images, video, documents and archives travel both ways; inbound media is decrypted to $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox and handed to the model as a path, and the agent sends files back through its wechat_send_file / wecom_send_file tools. Sensitive operations can be approved from the chat itself (reply 1 to allow once, 2 to reject; unanswered requests fall back to the GUI after a timeout), and a card panel lists every contact and group with Allow / Ignore / Clear plus an optional allowlist mode. WeCom works three ways - group-robot webhook, self-built app, and a two-way intelligent robot over its long connection, which needs no public URL or callback; a WeCom chat gets the same sessions, allowlist, approvals and reply relay as WeChat. Accounts, receive cursors, session routes and allowlist decisions persist under $DSH_HOME, so restarting dsh keeps the login and one click re-pairs. No OpenClaw install, no external service and no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的个人微信 + 企业微信桥：在插件面板扫码配对（支持多个微信号同时在线），之后在微信或企业微信里和 agent 对话，每个联系人/群各自一个独立 DSH 会话。文字、图片、视频、文档、压缩包双向互通；收到的媒体解密落盘到 $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox 并以路径交给模型，agent 可通过 wechat_send_file / wecom_send_file 工具把文件发回。敏感操作可以在聊天里直接审批（回 1 批准一次、回 2 拒绝；超时未回复自动转回 GUI），卡片面板列出所有联系人与群，可逐条允许/忽略/清除，并提供可选的「只接收白名单」模式。企业微信有三条链路：群机器人 webhook、自建应用、以及双向的智能机器人长连接（不需要公网地址或回调），企微会话与微信一样共享同一套会话、白名单、远程审批与回复中继。账号、收消息游标、会话路由与白名单决定都持久化在 $DSH_HOME，重启 dsh 保留登录、一键可重新配对。不需要安装 OpenClaw、不需要外部服务、无运行时依赖。
